# 2 Clement — Chapter 14 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 14
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Therefore, brothers, by doing the will of God our Father we shall belong to the first church — the spiritual one, that which was created before the sun and moon. But if we do not do the will of the Lord, we shall belong to the scripture that says: "My house has become a den of robbers." So let us choose to belong to the church of life, in order that we may be saved.
2. Now I do not suppose you are ignorant that the living church is the body of Christ. For the scripture says: "God made the human being male and female." The male is Christ, the female is the church. And the books and the apostles declare that the church belongs not to the present but existed before all things. For she was spiritual, as also was our Jesus, and was revealed in the last days so that she might save us.
3. The church, being spiritual, was manifested in the flesh of Christ, indicating to us that if any of us guard it in the flesh and do not corrupt it, he will receive it back in the Holy Spirit.
4. For this flesh is the antitype and image of the Spirit. No one, therefore, who has corrupted the copy shall receive the original as his share.
5. This therefore is what he means, brothers: guard the flesh so that you may receive the Spirit.
6. But if we say that the flesh is the church and the Spirit is Christ, then the one who has maltreated the flesh has maltreated the church. Such a person, then, shall not receive the Spirit, which is Christ.
7. So great a life and immortality can this flesh receive, if the Holy Spirit is joined to it. No one is able to declare or tell what the Lord has prepared for his chosen ones.
